requirement: Configure happy-qijie daemon instance identical to happy-jade, using production environment

clarifications.account: Create new account with arbitrary token via privacy-kit (like dev account), no QR
clarifications.server: Same production server as jade/default: http://188.245.32.161:3000
clarifications.autostart: Yes, enabled in systemd like jade
clarifications.source: Uses global binary /usr/bin/happy (same as jade/default, NOT like dev which uses /root/happy-dev/)

tasks.description: Generate new account on server via privacy-kit token
tasks.command: docker exec happy-server node -e "const { createPersistentTokenGenerator } = require('privacy-kit'); const gen = createPersistentTokenGenerator({ service: 'handy', seed: 'adocKlifsn8A09BTADtSPpb+F0F6Z9atZC5GciycNt0=' }); const { createId } = require('@paralleldrive/cuid2'); const id = createId(); const token = gen.new({ user: id }); console.log(JSON.stringify({ accountId: id, token }));"
tasks.notes: Need to check if @paralleldrive/cuid2 is available in the container, otherwise generate ID differently

tasks.description: Generate NaCl encryption keys (box keypair + AES machineKey)
tasks.method: Use node with tweetnacl or libsodium to generate random keypair and machineKey

tasks.description: Write access.key with token + encryption keys
Create systemd service file (clone from jade, change HAPPY_HOME_DIR)
Update /root/bin/happy-session-recovery.sh - add /root/.happy-qijie to HAPPY_HOMES array and case statement
Start daemon and verify it connects to server

success_criteria: /root/.happy-qijie/access.key has valid token and encryption keys
Daemon starts and creates daemon.state.json with PID and httpPort
Daemon connects to server (check logs for WebSocket connection)
Session recovery script includes /root/.happy-qijie in HAPPY_HOMES
safety_rules: DO NOT stop/restart any existing daemons (default, jade, dev)
DO NOT invoke /usr/bin/happy directly from this agent
DO NOT modify any existing access.key files
DO NOT touch production web images or containers
